In detail

Settecamini is a peripheral, semi-suburban area at the eastern edge of Rome along Via Tiburtina, mixing residential streets with some rural land. Local press has repeatedly reported large drug-trafficking seizures based here, including an apartment described as a 'fortress' where 5kg of drugs, an illegal firearm and 20,000 euro were seized, a separate 50kg drug haul found in a car, and another seizure of roughly half a quintal of hashish and cocaine. There has also been reported vandalism that residents described as leaving the neighbourhood 'in crisi'. These findings point to real drug-trafficking activity based in or passing through Settecamini plus documented vandalism, meriting a yellow rating both day and night.
